reportTitle: Phase 7A.6R3 Settings Sync State, Mutex Linearization, Worker Provenance & Non-Cancellable Boundary Closure

fixA_SettingsSyncPersistentStateAndSchem.description: Comprehensive SettingsSyncState representation and backward-compatible metadata validation preserving user preference across restarts and failures.

mechanisms.activeMetadataPersistence: writeActiveMetadataAtomically persists settingsSyncState alongside boolean settingsSynced and optional settingsSyncError
mechanisms.schemaCompatibility: validateActiveMetadata accepts both modern (settingsSyncState) and legacy metadata, accurately reconstructing settingsSyncState without dropping fields during serialization roundtrips
mechanisms.statusSummaryExposure: ActivationCoordinator.getStatusSummary() and GET /dictionary/status expose verified settingsSyncState
mechanisms.recoveryConvergence: Startup recovery and removal correctly reconcile unconfirmed settings sync states, attempting retry when appropriate

fixB_StartupRestorationAndOperationSeria.description: Linearized ownership acquisition before first await in both install and remove workflows, closing async interleaving windows.

mechanisms.synchronousMutexAcquisition: install() and remove() atomically acquire in-flight ownership synchronously prior to any async operation
mechanisms.removeSettlementTracking: ActiveRemoveContext tracks in-flight remove() settlement promise (#activeRemove), allowing concurrent calls to immediately reject with 409 OperationInProgressError
mechanisms.startupRecoveryCoordination: Both install and remove synchronize on activationCoordinator.ensureReady() before initiating storage mutations
mechanisms.lifecycleSequentiality: Full sequential install -> remove -> install lifecycles proceed without lock contamination or abandoned handles

fixC_CordisDisposeAndRunningRemoveDrainW.description: Complete Cordis lifecycle disposal draining both active install and active remove operations with authentic worker exit proof verification.

mechanisms.dualWorkflowDrain: opMan.dispose(timeoutMs) handles both active install and active remove contexts, awaiting their settlement promises under timeout guard
mechanisms.workerExitProofVerification: Verifies authentic worker exit proofs using WorkerSupervisor.isExitProofAuthentic and branded exit proof tokens
mechanisms.drainTimeoutSafety: Throws OperationDrainTimeoutError when drain fails to complete within timeout, recording workerExited=false, timedOut=true, and statusUnknown=true
mechanisms.disposedStateInvariants: Once disposed, manager rejects subsequent install() and remove() calls immediately with OperationManagerDisposedError and reports canInstall=false, canRemove=false

fixD_CancellationCommitBoundariesAndStat.description: Linearized commit boundary at atomic metadata write, rejecting post-commit cancellation with 409 OPERATION_NOT_CANCELLABLE.

mechanisms.commitBoundaryLinearization: Activation coordinator invokes onCommitBoundary immediately before writeActiveMetadataAtomically, locking the operation as non-cancellable
mechanisms.preCommitCancellation: Cancellations arriving prior to commit point abort gracefully, cleanly clean up candidate artifacts, and settle as 'cancelled'
mechanisms.postCommitCancellationRefusal: cancel() throws OperationNotCancellableError if requested after commit boundary, returning HTTP 409 OPERATION_NOT_CANCELLABLE and preserving committed active database
mechanisms.canCancelAlignment: opMan.canCancel() synchronously reflects whether the active operation can still be cancelled

verifiedInvariants.E2E-01: Unauthenticated route fence returning 401 on all management routes without DSH session
verifiedInvariants.E2E-02: Zero external network requests on initial boot, initial GET status query returning activeMode: 'fixture'
verifiedInvariants.E2E-03: Protocol gating enforcing 405/404 method, 415 content-type, 413 body size <= 64 KiB, 400 forbidden parameters
verifiedInvariants.E2E-04: Concurrency mutex rejecting overlapping install/remove with 409, cancellation dispatch smoothly settling to 'cancelled'
verifiedInvariants.E2E-05: Full streaming installation and live activation (770,611 entries, 57,689 forms) with non-fixture words hitting in ecdict-local
verifiedInvariants.E2E-06: Cross-process restart restoration verifying that subsequent DSH process restarts directly into managed-ecdict without re-download
verifiedInvariants.E2E-07: Settings sync state verification and schema compatibility across restart (settingsSyncState: 'synced')
verifiedInvariants.E2E-08: Safe removal releasing Windows SQLite locks, unlinking managed database, and hot-reverting queries to fixture
